app.name: OpenLight
app.tagline: Your lights follow the colors on your screen.

color_mode.title: Color mode
color_mode.help: Dominant: the color you see the most in the zone. Average: the mix of the whole zone.

saturation.title: Color boost
saturation.help: Multiplies saturation. Higher means more intense colors.

brightness_min.title: Minimum brightness
brightness_min.help: Light brightness when the screen is dark.

brightness_max.title: Maximum brightness
brightness_max.help: Brightness cap when the screen is very bright. It doesn't turn the light off: use "Remove from effect" or "Turn off" for that.

smoothing_ms.title: Smoothing
smoothing_ms.help: Higher means slower, flicker-free transitions. Scene cuts are always faster.

send_channel.title: Light channel
send_channel.help: How colors are sent to the light. If colors look choppy, try the control channel.

capture_fps.title: Captures per second
capture_fps.help: How many times per second the screen is read. Higher is faster but uses more power.

max_sends_per_s.title: Commands per second
max_sends_per_s.help: Maximum colors sent to the light per second. Lower it if the light stutters.

send_threshold.title: Send threshold
send_threshold.help: Changes smaller than this are not sent, since you can't see them.

black_bar.title: Black bars
black_bar.help: Rows and columns darker than this count as black bars and don't affect brightness.

grey_threshold.title: Grey threshold
grey_threshold.help: Below this saturation the screen counts as grey and the light turns white.

dark_screen.title: Dark screen
dark_screen.help: Below this brightness the last color is kept instead of turning white.

hue_stickiness.title: Hue stability
hue_stickiness.help: Keeps the light from jumping between two colors that cover almost the same area.

no_screen_wait_s.title: Wait without screen
no_screen_wait_s.help: With no screen for this long, the light goes back to how it was until the screen returns.

heartbeat_s.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat_s.help: How often the light is told the connection is still alive.

dead_after_s.title: Connection dead after
dead_after_s.help: With no reply from the light for this long, it reconnects.

settings.title: Settings

scope_note.global: You change the values for every bulb. Each bulb and profile can override any of them.
scope_note.device: Only this bulb. Settings with a dashed border are inherited from the global ones.
scope_note.profile: What you save here applies while the profile is active.

settings.more_hidden: There are {n} more settings in the next levels.
settings.preview_on: Changes show on the bulb while you move the control.
settings.preview_off: Start the effect to see changes live.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.help: A profile stores a set of values. Switch it here, on the dashboard, from the tray or with its shortcut.
profiles.press_keys: Press the combination… (Esc cancels, Delete removes it)

screen_permission_denied.title: Screen Recording permission missing
screen_permission_denied.detail: Without it the screen can't be read. Turn it on in Settings and reopen OpenLight.

local_network_denied.title: Local Network permission missing
local_network_denied.detail: Without it the lights can't be reached. Turn it on in System Settings.

firewall_blocked.title: The firewall blocks light discovery
firewall_blocked.detail: Allow OpenLight in the firewall to find the lights on your network.

capture_unsupported.title: Screen capture isn't available
capture_unsupported.detail: Your desktop doesn't offer a way to share the screen (ScreenCast portal).

no_display.title: No display
no_display.detail: No screen is on right now. OpenLight will resume when one shows up.

device_not_found.title: Can't find the light
device_not_found.detail: Make sure it's on and the computer is on the same Wi-Fi.

device_not_found_on_lan.title: I couldn't find the bulb on your network
device_not_found_on_lan.detail: It didn't show up in the search, so I don't know its IP or protocol version. Make sure it is switched on at the wall and on the same Wi-Fi as this computer, and that no other program is using it (Smart Life, the old script). Then search again.

lan_scan_failed.title: I couldn't listen to the network to find the bulb
lan_scan_failed.detail: Close other programs that use your bulbs (Smart Life, the old script), check the Local Network permission or the firewall, and search again. {detail}

device_key_rejected.title: The light rejected the key
device_key_rejected.detail: The local key changed (error 914). Renew it with one click.

device_timeout.title: The light isn't responding
device_timeout.detail: It may be switched off at the wall or too far from the router.

device_busy.title: Another app is using the light
device_busy.detail: Close the Smart Life app on your phone: it sometimes holds the light's local connection.

device_in_effect.title: This light is following the screen
device_in_effect.detail: To control, calibrate or test it, remove it from the effect: the others keep going. You can add it back afterwards.

device_in_use.title: OpenLight is already using this light
device_in_use.detail: Wait for the calibration, test or manual control to finish and try again.

device_no_colour.title: This device can't show colors
device_no_colour.detail: It only has white light, so it can't follow the screen.

cloud_invalid_signature.title: The Access Secret doesn't match
cloud_invalid_signature.detail: It was probably copied wrong. Copy it again from iot.tuya.com.

cloud_invalid_token.title: The Tuya session expired
cloud_invalid_token.detail: Try again; if it persists, check the Access ID.

cloud_permission_denied.title: Tuya denied access
cloud_permission_denied.detail: Check that you linked your Smart Life account to the project and picked the right Data Center.

cloud_wrong_region.title: Wrong Data Center
cloud_wrong_region.detail: Your credentials work in {region}. Switch to it?

cloud_service_not_authorized.title: A service is missing from the project
cloud_service_not_authorized.detail: Add the IoT Core service to your Cloud project.

cloud_trial_expired.title: The IoT Core trial expired
cloud_trial_expired.detail: You can extend it for free at iot.tuya.com. It's only needed to renew keys.

cloud_no_credentials.title: Tuya credentials are missing
cloud_no_credentials.detail: You haven't saved the Access ID and Access Secret yet. Paste them in the credentials step and try again.

no_zones.title: No bulb has a zone
no_zones.detail: Choose which part of the screen each bulb follows before starting.

brightness_range.title: Maximum brightness can't be below the minimum
brightness_range.detail: A minimum of {min}% and a maximum of {max}% leave no range. Raise the maximum or lower the minimum. To turn a light off use "Remove from effect" or "Turn off".

invalid_setting.title: Invalid value
invalid_setting.detail: The {setting} setting doesn't accept that value.

storage.title: Couldn't save the settings
storage.detail: Check that there's free disk space.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.detail: Export the diagnostics and open an issue so we can look into it.

explain.idle: Your bulbs are as you left them. Start to make them follow the screen.
explain.connecting: Connecting to the bulbs over the local network…
explain.active: Your bulbs follow the colors on your screen.
explain.paused: No screen: the bulbs went back to their state and resume on their own when it returns.
explain.restoring: Putting the bulbs back as they were…

disconnect_help.peer_closed: Some bulbs do this often: OpenLight reconnects on its own. If it happens a lot, lower “Commands per second”.
disconnect_help.timeout: The bulb was slow to answer. It may be far from the router.
disconnect_help.no_response: The bulb stopped answering heartbeats. Was it turned off at the wall switch?
disconnect_help.key_rejected: The local key changed. Renew it from Devices.
disconnect_help.refused: Another app (Smart Life) may be holding the bulb.
disconnect_help.io: Network problem on the computer or router.

screen_recording.title: Screen Recording
screen_recording.why: To see the colors on screen. The image never leaves your computer.

local_network.title: Local Network
local_network.why: To find the bulbs and talk to them directly over your Wi-Fi.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.why: To hear the bulbs' announcements on the network (UDP).

screen_cast_portal.title: Screen sharing (portal)
screen_cast_portal.why: On Wayland, the desktop asks which screen to share.

zones.keys: Drag the zone or use the keyboard: arrows move it, Shift + arrows resize it, Alt for fine steps.

welcome.title: Your bulbs, following your screen
welcome.lead: OpenLight watches the colors on your monitor and sends them to your Smart Life bulbs over the local network. Setting it up takes about 15 minutes, once.

bulbs.title: Bulbs in Smart Life
bulbs.text: Already added in the phone app, with color.

wifi.title: The same Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The computer and the bulbs on the same network.

time.title: About 15 minutes
time.text: With your phone at hand to scan a QR.

welcome.why_text: Each bulb has a local key that can only be read from the Tuya portal. OpenLight reads it once; after that everything works without internet or cloud.
welcome.import_title: Were you using the ambilight.py script?
welcome.import_text: Import devices.json, config.json and calibracion.json from its folder and skip most of the setup.
welcome.import_hint: For example ~/Documents/Open RGB. The keys move to the system keychain.

permissions.title: System permissions
permissions.lead: OpenLight needs to see the screen and talk to the bulbs on your network. Nothing leaves your computer.
permissions.none_needed: This system needs no special permissions.
permissions.auto: It re-checks on its own every few seconds.
permissions.restart: macOS requires reopening the app after enabling Screen Recording. When you come back, setup continues from here.

tuya_account.title: Create your Tuya Developer account
tuya_account.lead: It's free and you only do it once.
tuya_account.needs: Tick the box when you have the account.
tuya_account.image_alt: The Tuya portal with the Sign Up button highlighted

cloud_project.title: Create the Cloud project
cloud_project.lead: It gives you the keys OpenLight needs to read your bulbs.
cloud_project.needs: Choose where you created your account and tick the box.
cloud_project.where: Where did you create your Smart Life account?
cloud_project.image_alt: Cloud → Development menu and the Create Cloud Project button

link_app.title: Link Smart Life to the project
link_app.lead: With a QR code, from your phone.
link_app.needs: Tick the box once you scanned the QR.
link_app.confirm: I linked my Smart Life account
link_app.image_alt: Phone with Smart Life scanning the portal's QR

credentials.title: Paste the Access ID and Access Secret
credentials.lead: OpenLight tests them with Tuya before moving on.
credentials.id_help: About 20 characters, in the project's Overview tab.
credentials.id_short: Looks incomplete: the Access ID has about 20 characters.
credentials.secret_help: 32 characters. Stored in the system keychain.
credentials.secret_length: The Access Secret has 32 characters and you pasted {n}.
credentials.ok: It works! Connected to Tuya in {region}.
credentials.saved: Keys are already saved. You can continue or test others.

choose_devices.title: Choose your bulbs
choose_devices.lead: These are the devices in your account. Tick the ones that should follow the screen.
choose_devices.scanning: Looking for the bulbs on your network…

test_devices.title: Test each bulb
test_devices.lead: You'll see red, green and blue, a second and a half each.
test_devices.needs: Confirm you saw the colors on each bulb.
test_devices.question: Did you see the three colors on {name}?

check.wifi: Are the computer and the bulb on the same Wi-Fi?
check.smart_life: Is the Smart Life app open on your phone? Close it: it sometimes holds the bulb.
check.switch: Is the bulb on at the wall switch?
check.key: Did you re-pair it recently? Then the key changed: renew it.

test_devices.empty: No bulbs yet. Go back one step.

zones.title: Monitor and zones
zones.lead: Choose which part of the screen each bulb follows. With two bulbs, left and right looks great.

calibrate.title: Calibrate the colors (recommended)
calibrate.lead: Each bulb renders colors its own way. In 5 minutes you match them to your monitor.
calibrate.why: You'll see 12 hues full screen and move the bulb until it matches. Quick mode uses 6.
calibrate.skip_hint: You can skip it and do it later from the dashboard.

done.title: All set!
done.lead: Everything is ready. Start it and play a colorful video.
done.tray_mac: OpenLight lives in the menu bar, top right: turn it on, switch profiles or quit from there.
done.tray_windows: OpenLight lives in the system tray, bottom right (it may be inside the little arrow).
done.tray_linux: OpenLight lives in your desktop panel's tray.

dashboard.empty_text: Add your bulbs with the setup assistant.
dashboard.no_zone: No area yet: choose what it follows in Devices.

devices.title: Your bulbs
devices.name: Name
devices.renewed: Key renewed. The bulb is connected again.
devices.remove_text: Its key is deleted from the keychain along with its calibration. You can add it again any time.

calibration.help: Look at the bulb and move the controls until its light looks like this color. Saturation above 100% only boosts pale colors.

ab.question: Question {n} of {total}: {setting}
ab.intro: You'll see option A and then B, six seconds each, while this window shows changing colors. Watch the bulb.
ab.which: Which one looked more like the screen?
ab.needs_session: To compare, the effect must be running.
ab.nothing: This bulb has no options to compare.

manual.title: Manual control
manual.scenes_from_app: This bulb has its own scenes. For now, choose them from the Smart Life app.
manual.in_effect: This light is following the screen. To control it by hand, remove it from the effect: the others keep going.
manual.remove_from_effect: Remove this light from the effect
manual.out_of_effect: This light is not in the effect: it stays as you leave it.
manual.add_to_effect: Add it back to the effect

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.no_session: Start the effect to see the capture and send charts.
diagnostics.no_secrets: The log and the export never include keys or the Access Secret.

tray.title: Tray menu
tray.explain: This is how the menu bar or system tray menu looks. The native app builds it with the same commands.
tray.quit_note: The bulbs went back to their state. In the real app, OpenLight would quit here.
tray.mock_help: Only shown in the browser, without Tauri. Useful to test the UI with real failures.

warning.calibration_single_device: calibracion.json was for a single bulb: it was applied to the first one. Calibrate the other from the dashboard.
warning.version_assumed: I couldn't find a bulb's protocol version and assumed 3.3. If it doesn't respond, try it again from Devices.
warning.no_key: A bulb had no local key. Renew it with one click from Devices (your Tuya account is needed).
warning.mapping_invalid: I couldn't read a bulb's data (its DPs). They will be detected when it connects.
warning.calibration_unassigned: I found a calibration but I don't know which bulb it belongs to. Calibrate each bulb from the dashboard.
warning.calibration_invalid: I couldn't read calibracion.json, so I ignored it. You can calibrate again from the dashboard.
warning.skipped_non_light: I skipped devices that are not lights (plugs, sensors).
warning.ip_invalid: An IP from the old setup is not valid and was ignored: it will be found automatically.

update.auto_help: OpenLight checks when it opens and every 6 hours. Nothing is installed unless you ask for it.
update.available_lead: You have {current}. It downloads, installs, and OpenLight reopens.

phase.restoring: Putting your bulbs back the way they were…

network.title: No connection
network.detail: We couldn't reach GitHub. Check that your computer is online and try again.

unavailable.title: We couldn't read the latest version
unavailable.detail: GitHub didn't return the update information. Try again in a while or download it from GitHub.

signature.title: The download failed the signature check
signature.detail: Nothing was installed. Try again; if it keeps happening, download the new version from the official page on GitHub.

unsupported.title: There's no automatic update for your system yet
unsupported.detail: Download the installer for the new version from GitHub and install it over this one.

permission.title: The app couldn't be replaced
permission.detail: OpenLight can't write where it's installed. On macOS, move it to the Applications folder, open it again and retry.

auth.title: Your authorization is needed
auth.detail: The system asked for your password to install and it was cancelled. Try again and type it.

install.title: Installation failed
install.detail: You're still on the previous version. Try again or download the installer from GitHub.

restart.title: Couldn't restart
restart.detail: Restart now, or quit OpenLight from the tray menu and open it again.
